tldr:
For fixed labelled binary potential outcomes, every subject has a noisy report but only \(m=\lfloor\rho n\rfloor\) distinct assigned outcomes can receive gold review. The unknown common symmetric reporting channel is learned from the same record. Put \(C(\rho)=9/(1+8\rho)\) and \(C_{\mathrm A}=4^{1/3}|a_\star|\), where \(a_\star\) is the largest negative zero of the Airy derivative. Uniformly for \(\rho\in[1/4,3/4]\), the proved minimax expansion is
\[
 R_n(\rho)=\frac{C(\rho)}n-C_{\mathrm A}C(\rho)^{2/3}n^{-4/3}+o(n^{-4/3}).
\]
The explicit blind procedure in Definition \texttt{def:localized-blind-rule} attains both orders using the original record, while the converse covers every ex ante treatment law, every legal sequential audit kernel, and every bounded randomized terminal decision. Blind and full minimax risks satisfy \(0\le R_n^{\mathrm b}-R_n=o(n^{-4/3})\) uniformly. Supporting proved finite certificates give arbitrarily accurate brackets and legal upper-certifying rules.
gap: Clean finite-population minimax theory evaluates unrestricted design and estimation, whereas two-phase causal efficiency theory concerns population parameters and regular estimators. Neither inspected theorem evaluates sharp realized-target risk when one unknown reporting channel must be learned within the same exact audit budget.
fill: The research target is an evaluated audit-fraction precision benchmark with a matched first correction and a proved comparison of blind and sequential auditing. Finite strategic experiments supply certificates, while policy-uniform conditional-target bounds certify optimality. Generic efficiency projection or an unevaluated minimax game is insufficient.
